mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.dept_id, d.real_name, d.title, d.fee, d.stock, d.expertise, dept.name AS dept_name, s.id AS s_id, s.work_date AS s_date, s.slot AS s_slot, s.max_num AS s_max FROM sys_doctor d LEFT JOIN sys_dept dept ON d.dept_id = dept.id LEFT JOIN sys_schedule s ON d.id = s.doctor_id AND s.work_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY d.id, s.work_date
SELECT DISTINCT d.name FROM sys_dept d WHERE d.name IS NOT NULL AND d.name != ''

SELECT t.id, t.real_name as realName, t.title, t.expertise, t.rating, t.dept_id, t.avatar, d.name as deptName FROM sys_doctor t LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON t.dept_id = d.id WHERE d.name = #{deptName} ORDER BY (CASE WHEN #{keyword} IS NOT NULL AND #{keyword} != '' AND t.expertise IS NOT NULL AND t.expertise LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, t.rating DESC

SELECT d.id, d.user_id as userId, d.dept_id as deptId, d.real_name as realName, d.title, d.fee, d.stock, d.expertise, d.rating, d.avatar, dept.name as deptName, dept.icon as deptIcon FROM sys_doctor d LEFT JOIN sys_dept dept ON d.dept_id = dept.id WHERE d.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_schedule (doctor_id, work_date, slot, max_num) VALUES (#{doctorId}, #{workDate}, #{slot}, #{maxNum})
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.user_id, d.dept_id, d.real_name as realName, d.title, d.fee, d.stock, d.expertise, d.rating, d.avatar, dept.name as deptName FROM sys_doctor d LEFT JOIN sys_dept dept ON d.dept_id = dept.id WHERE d.id = #{id}
SELECT real_name FROM sys_doctor WHERE id = #{doctorId}

SELECT d.id, d.real_name, d.title, d.expertise, d.rating, d.dept_id, d.avatar, dept.name as deptName FROM sys_doctor d LEFT JOIN sys_dept dept ON d.dept_id = dept.id WHERE d.expertise IS NOT NULL AND d.expertise != ''

SELECT d.id, d.real_name as realName, d.title, d.expertise, d.rating, d.dept_id, d.avatar, dept.name as deptName FROM sys_doctor d LEFT JOIN sys_dept dept ON d.dept_id = dept.id WHERE d.id IN
#{id}
